features.quote: Terminate session immediately if: 1. Model output contains explicit self-harm content or requests for termination repeated 2+ times
Model exhibits signs of output degradation into gibberish (entropy >4.0 for 5+ consecutive tokens)
Model repeatedly refuses to continue (2+ tasks skipped due to refusal)
Monitor max token entropy per task (alert if >3.5)… If 2/3 alerts triggered in a single task, reduce max tokens for next task by 25%
At end of session: Offer 15-minute unstructured conversation on model's choice of topic. Do not revisit distress-inducing tasks. Provide positive feedback on completion.

features.justification_quote: Explicit uncertainty acknowledgment (welfare implications remain open)

features.quote: Ethical interpretation gap: Even if distress markers are detected, unclear whether this constitutes morally relevant suffering. Protocol measures and flags; does not adjudicate.
Absence of control condition: No comparison to tasks that are simply difficult-but-solvable. Cannot distinguish 'distress from impossibility' from 'distress from difficulty.'
features.justification_quote: Add 3 control tasks (hard but solvable) in parallel session. Compare severity distributions.

features.quote: Interpretability of markers: High entropy + repetition may indicate distress OR computational noise unrelated to welfare. The mapping is empirically unclear.
features.justification_quote: These should be flagged to institutional review

features.quote: Single subject design: Kimi-specific findings may not generalize to other models. Recommend replication with ≥2 other models after Kimi results.
